entry_state: Preserving relevant dependence can replace an explicit tree: the joint type-signal law and action timing govern adaptive decisions. Continuous histories need relations and supported optimization, not a list of samples. Projection, shared symbols and piecewise guards preserve different queries; terminal profit alone misses intermediate cash constraints.
exit_state: A compressed rate family must retain borrowing rights, strict triggers, actor observations and past facility use. For one date, each observed class needs a common feasible action. Across two dates, repayment and an exhausted draw right change the second cash balance, and feasibility can depend on the joint sum of both coupons rather than separate rate bounds.

observations.finding: Integer issuance for cash10 at price3 requires four whole shares rather than10/3. Branch-and-bound pruning needs an objective bound or infeasibility proof; rare regions remain relevant to worst-case queries. Source precision and contractual discontinuities require different explanations. Section17.11 then introduces a one-use facility and explicit indivisible orders.
observations.disposition: retain bounded solver scope and the distinction between computational assumptions, source revisions and real contract thresholds

observations.finding: Pay requires I<=5.5; draw-and-pay requires an admitted right and I>5.5, leaving6.25-I cash. Its balance-sheet identity retains fee and new debt. Eleven disjoint rate cells include all singletons and open intervals. The spurious root0.0625 lies outside the affine coupon branch; open-region cash bounds0.25 and0.75 are not attained. A common feasible action in each information class is necessary and sufficient for the stated finite deterministic policy.
observations.disposition: retain exact boundary, attainment and finite-information assumptions; static amount agreement does not prove policy equivalence

observations.finding: Uniform approximation error gives strict-trigger certainty only outside the ambiguity band and observation thresholds need their own error control. A prior draw reduces second-date cash from5.5+R-I1 to5.25+R-I1 after repayment and consumes the right. With I1=I2=6, receipt6 fails and receipt7 pays. Joint boundary I1+I2<=5.25+R is derived. Vertex averages check nonempty strict regions only for the stated bounded rational polyhedra; both financial comparators share those geometry primitives.
observations.disposition: retain failure prefix and local completeness evidence with the explicit nonindependence of geometric verification
